name: Fushigi no Kuni no Kanojo
original_name: 不思議の国のカノジョ
source:
Main character belongs to the literary club "Girl of Memories" and struggles every day to complete a novel. One day, a mysterious girl "Negai" appears before him to fulfill his destiny, but in fact she is a delusional girl from the novel. She is invisible for others, but clingy enough to support with advice at every step.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角隶属于文学社“回忆少女”，每天为完成一部小说而奋斗。有一天，一位神秘的女孩“Negai”出现在他面前，以完成他的命运，但实际上她是小说中的一个妄想女孩。她对其他人来说是隐形的，但足够粘人，会在每一步中提供建议。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
